title: Build JasonShell Performance Measurement Harness
description: Build a JasonShell performance measurement harness for startup, per-window memory, bundle/binary size, and IPC latency. Problem: FN-004 identified major measurement gaps: no automated cold-start to AppBar/first-paint timestamp, no per-window WebView2 memory report, no JS parse/evaluate timing per surface, and no native binary attribution. Target metric: make future optimization tasks evidence-backed. Likely file scope: dev-only scripts under `scripts/`, diagnostics/runtime metrics modules, docs. Acceptance criteria: harness runs without changing release behavior; records dist asset sizes, release exe/bundle sizes when available, startup milestones, window count, memory/process snapshots, and selected IPC timings; docs explain how to run; validation passes.

steps.name: Add backend runtime metrics and IPC timing commands
